earnings.title: Earnings Release
highlights: Third qu arter net inc ome of $4.6 billion, and diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $5.28
Third quarter adjusted net income of $4.7 billion, and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.31
Third quarter net revenue of $9.8 billion, an increase of 14%, as reported and on a currency-neutral basis

quotes.text: Another strong quarter for Mastercard, delivering net revenue growth of 14%. More Mastercard credentials in more hands give us a powerful foundation, backed by our global reach and innovation.

items.heading: Global regulatory and legislative activity related to the payments industry may have a material adverse impact on our overall business and results of operations.
Increased activity with respect to interchange rates could have an adverse impact on our business.
Limitations on our ability to restrict merchant surcharging could materially and adversely impact our results of operations.
Preferential or protective government actions related to domestic payment services could adversely affect our ability to maintain or increase our revenues.

Regulation and enforcement of privacy, data, AI, information security and the digital economy could increase our costs and lead to legal claims and fines, as well as negatively impact our growth and reputation.
items.group: Privacy, Data, AI and Information Security

items.heading: Regulations that directly or indirectly apply to Mastercard as a result of our participation in the global payments industry may materially and adversely affect our overall business and results of operations.
